data.title: Legend of the Black Dragon Warrior
data.description:
Xiao Shuxiang, a teenager who lives in a remote village near the Five Finger Mountains. When he and some of his friends returned from hunting, the village where he lived was burned down and both of his parents died in the incident.

Since his parents died, he was raised by an Elder from the Black Dragon Sect. He was also considered his adopted son and became part of the Black Dragon Sect. It's just a shame that Xiao Shuxiang doesn't have the talent to become a cultivator.

However, through an unfortunate incident, he managed to find the secret of the jade necklace given by his father. From there, he also got a cultivation technique that shook the world. Strangely, the jade turned out to have a close relationship with the Guardian Dragon of the Sect where Xiao Shuxiang was.

data.title: Reincarnated As A Baby? My Cry Is A Dragon Roar!
data.description:
This story is not mine

Reincarnated as a baby who was in his mother’s womb for a hundred years, the moment Lin Xuan was born, the whole world was shocked.
When he took his first breath, he gathered all the purple qi from 30,000 miles east. He was dubbed the Saint Child by others.
When he let out his first cry, it helped all of the cultivators around him break through their limits.
When he first opened his eyes, his parents mastered the Divine Eyes technique.
When he first moved his fingers, he tore open a crack in space. It was the Devastating Finger.
When he took his first step, cracks formed on the crust of the earth. It was the Chaotic Eight Steps.
When he first spoke, first ate, and first showered…
His Ancestor praised, “He’s the pride of our family.”
The Holy Maiden argued, “He’s mine!”
The Empress announced, “I’m willing to wait until he’s an adult!”
Buddda’s apprentice cursed, “Why am I meditating here? I can break through just by being close to him!"

data.title: Broker: The Chained Dragon [经纪人：锁链之龙]
data.description:
Li Chengjue sets out to the village of Cangwu to fulfil his mother's last wish. "Find what we lost". He is on a quest to bring back that which was lost so as to rule as King and Emperor in the Empire of Dayu. He leaves unknown to his subjects as Mo Xuanye, Commander of the Eastern Depot of Dayu takes his chance and sets eyes on the throne.

Li Chengjue holds a Gold Dragon Jade created by Emperor Dayu, the founder of Dayu Dynasty, Empire 800 years ago. A White Phoenix Jade was also created by Emperor Dayu making the Twin Imperial Seal a proof that the Heavens has given the Mandate. Without both Jades, the empire bleeds. Li Chengjue must find the other half of the Imperial Seal before Mo Xuanye does assuming full power. In his quest, he encounters an abomination that stays secret in the palace.

Dayu is crumbling each passing day, Mo Xuanye is doing everything in his power to paint Li Chengjue black and depose him. Could Li Chengjue find the Phoenix Jade in time before Dayu burns?
